[Context: Professional summary — Hugo Enrique Virgen Herrera, Senior Fullstack Engineer | Design Systems | AI Integrations | Cloud | Node.js | TypeScript | C# | Angular | .NET]
Senior Fullstack Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience in JavaScript and TypeScript, specializing in building scalable, high-performance web and backend applications using Node.js. Strong background in designing cloud-native systems with a focus on performance, maintainability, and clean architecture. Experienced in AI-powered integrations using LangChain and OpenAI APIs, building conversational platforms that unify isolated enterprise systems. Proven experience with Node.js orchestration and Azure-based serverless architectures, including Azure Functions and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in microservices architectures, integrating Node.js and .NET services to handle data-intensive workloads, optimize performance, and maintain conversational context across distributed systems. Brings deep expertise in frontend architecture and component-driven design systems, building Angular applications with strict ARIA/WCAG accessibility patterns. Proficient in end-to-end testing automation with Playwright, ensuring quality and reliability across web platforms.

[Skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, LangChain]
[Context: Senior Software Developer at PwC, 2024-08-present]
Contributed to the design, implementation, and production release of AI-powered integration services that unified 5+ isolated enterprise systems into a single conversational platform, with a strong focus on code quality, scalability, and reliable delivery pipelines.

[Skills: NestJS, LangChain, OpenAI API, .NET 8, Azure]
[Context: Enterprise AI Conversational Platform at PwC, 2024-08-present]
Employees manually repeated HR operations (vacation requests, sick leave, feedback, training enrollment) across up to 3 separate internal and external platforms. Built a unified conversational entry point that interprets natural language and executes the appropriate actions automatically. Designed and built an AI agent orchestration layer with NestJS, LangChain, and the OpenAI API, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and function calling to interpret user intent and execute actions against internal and third-party services, replacing manual multi-platform workflows with a single conversational interface. Designed and built a context engineering service in .NET 8 supporting the RAG pipeline — managing context retrieval for repeated, interrupted, and asynchronous conversational requests; evaluated Rust as the initial candidate, then aligned to corporate governance constraints (.NET or Node.js only), selecting .NET 8 for its performance profile. Built 3 framework-specific SDKs (React, Angular, Vue) exposing a floating chatbot widget that extracts the Active Directory payload, identifies the user, and forwards an auth token — supporting internal, second-party, and external consumer integrations.

[Skills: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Angular]
[Context: Senior Fullstack Node.js Developer at Globant, 2021-04 to 2024-08]
Joined as Senior Fullstack Node.js Developer and was promoted to Lead Backend Developer, leading a team of 4-6 engineers across two major engagements for a US-based enterprise SaaS provider — spanning backend architecture, SDK ecosystem development, and workflow automation, within AWS-based cloud environments.

[Skills: NestJS, GraphQL, Angular, React, Vue]
[Context: Enterprise SaaS Platform — Backend Architecture & SDK Ecosystem at Globant, 2021-04 to 2024-08]
The client needed a scalable backend architecture to support 50K+ daily API requests and SDK distribution for 10+ third-party integrators across Angular, React, and Vue. Promoted from Senior to Lead Backend Developer; led a team of 4-6 engineers responsible for NestJS backend services, GraphQL APIs, and supporting SDK architecture serving 50K+ daily API requests. Built frontend SDKs (Angular, React, Vue) adopted by 10+ third-party clients, standardizing integration patterns and reducing per-client onboarding effort. Implemented GraphQL APIs within a NestJS architecture, improving API flexibility, data aggregation, and developer experience for internal and external consumers. Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and CodePipeline, enabling consistent, repeatable releases across distributed services.

[Skills: AWS Step Functions]
[Context: Workflow Automation & Enterprise AI Evangelism at Globant, 2021-04 to 2024-08]
The client needed to automate multi-step backend workflows still running with manual intervention. Simultaneously, enterprise AI adoption was in its early "taboo" phase — leadership was cautious and there were no internal guidelines for responsible AI integration. Implemented workflow orchestration using AWS Step Functions for business process automation — replacing manual sequential workflows with fault-tolerant state machines across 3 distributed services. Championed enterprise AI adoption when LLM usage was organizationally discouraged — evangelized best practices for responsible AI integration in enterprise contexts, covering data governance, prompt safety, and cost control. Contributed to internal AI readiness assessment, evaluating integration patterns and tooling that informed the team's approach to generative AI adoption.

[Skills: Angular, C#, .NET, .NET Core, Azure DevOps]
[Context: Lead Full Stack JavaScript Engineer at Unosquare, 2020-03 to 2021-05]
Led a cross-functional team of 5+ engineers in the migration of a banking web application to Angular 11, while also contributing to backend services in C#/.NET, cloud-native architecture on Azure, and microservices in Golang. Designed and developed backend services using C# and .NET / .NET Core, integrating seamlessly with Angular-based frontends and enterprise data sources. Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, improving deployment reliability, automation, and release velocity.

[Skills: Angular, C#, .NET, .NET Core, Azure DevOps]
[Context: Lead Full Stack JavaScript Engineer at Unosquare, 2020-03 to 2021-05]
Contributed to cloud-native architectures on Azure, including Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure Functions, supporting scalable and resilient microservices. Developed lightweight microservices using Golang and Fiber, optimizing performance and service scalability within distributed systems.

[Skills: Angular, Playwright, .NET, .NET Core]
[Context: Digital Banking Platform Migration & A11y Compliance at Unosquare, 2020-03 to 2021-05]
The client had a legacy Angular 1.6 banking application serving 20K+ active users that needed migration to modern Angular. Additionally, the platform faced ADA Title III compliance pressure requiring full WCAG accessibility remediation under legal deadline. Led a team of 5+ engineers in migrating Angular 1.6 to Angular 10/11 using hybrid compilation mode, delivering zero downtime for 20K+ active banking users. Defined the team's test strategy and built a test automation framework with Playwright within 6 weeks of its public release (January 31, 2020), positioning the QA stack ahead of industry adoption and validating that migrated flows behaved identically to legacy. Led an accessibility compliance initiative under active ADA Title III legal pressure — trained all developers and QA engineers on WCAG standards and tooling, remediated existing accessibility debt, and integrated automated accessibility checks into the Playwright e2e suite. Implemented state management with NgRx/Store and component testing with Spectator across the Angular SDK architecture. Contributed to backend modernization across legacy .NET and .NET Core services using CQRS and Event Sourcing patterns.

[Skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL]
[Context: Full Stack JavaScript Engineer at EPAM Systems, 2018-10 to 2020-02]
Contributed to cloud modernization and platform engineering initiatives at EPAM, spanning post-incident infrastructure recovery for a Fortune 500 pharmaceutical client and high-volume platform development for a digital registration service, with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and clean architecture.

[Skills: AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions]
[Context: Fortune 500 Pharmaceutical — Post-Incident Cloud Modernization at EPAM Systems, 2018-10 to 2020-02]
The client's infrastructure was compromised by a catastrophic ransomware attack (2017) that froze all machines simultaneously. The entire technology stack needed to be rebuilt with a cloud-first, decentralized architecture to eliminate single points of failure and prevent future lateral propagation. Co-designed the decentralization strategy — decomposing a monolith into independent microservices with isolated databases, AWS Lambda functions, and Step Functions orchestration — for a Fortune 500 client recovering from a catastrophic infrastructure compromise. Produced system decomposition proposals, architectural diagrams, and migration strategies under strict post-breach security compartmentalization, delivering architecture guidance within constrained implementation access protocols.

[Skills: React, Node.js, Apollo GraphQL, AWS Lambda, AWS SNS]
[Context: High-Volume User Registration Platform at EPAM Systems, 2018-10 to 2020-02]
The client needed a scalable platform for processing 100K+ monthly user registrations with reliable email subscription workflows. Built a high-volume registration platform handling 100K+ monthly sign-ups using React, Node.js, Apollo GraphQL, AWS Lambda, SNS, and DynamoDB. Established automated test coverage using Mocha, Chai, and Istanbul, hardening reliability for high-volume registration and subscription flows.

[Context: Resources Manager (Leadership Development) at EPAM Systems, 2019-05 to 2020-02]
Additional leadership development role alongside primary engineering responsibilities. Acted as point of contact for engineers, supporting career growth, performance assessments, structured feedback, and one-on-one meetings. Conducted technical interviews to evaluate candidates on engineering fundamentals, problem-solving skills, and system design. Produced technical evaluation reports and hiring recommendations for HR and engineering leadership.

[Context: Resources Manager (Leadership Development) at EPAM Systems, 2019-05 to 2020-02]
Delivered technical talks and knowledge-sharing sessions for colleagues and engineering students, contributing to internal training initiatives.

[Skills: JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS]
[Context: Full-stack Software Engineer at 3Pillar Global (formerly Tiempo Development), 2016-10 to 2018-10]
Contributed to the design and development of microservices-based systems at 3Pillar Global, spanning a life-safety-critical emergency response platform for assisted living facilities and a legacy backend modernization initiative for an online IT training platform, following Agile/Scrum and Lean methodologies with a strong emphasis on scalability, reliability, and delivery quality.

[Skills: Node.js, WebSocket]
[Context: Senior Living Emergency Response System at 3Pillar Global (formerly Tiempo Development), 2016-10 to 2018-10]
The client's emergency response system for assisted living facilities relied on UDP-based data from help buttons and door/window sensors — packets were being silently dropped due to UDP's unreliable delivery, while web and iOS clients polled every 30 seconds simulating "real-time" alerts. In a system where a missed alert means a vulnerable resident does not receive help, both problems were life-safety defects. Diagnosed a life-safety defect in the emergency alert pipeline — UDP packet loss combined with 30-second polling — and proposed and implemented Node.js with Socket.IO to deliver true real-time event streaming over TCP/WebSocket, eliminating both data loss and response delay. Built a push notification system alerting caretakers when they left the facility's LAN boundary, closing a critical coverage gap in the elder care safety system.

[Skills: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS, GraphQL]
[Context: Online IT Training Content Platform at 3Pillar Global (formerly Tiempo Development), 2016-10 to 2018-10]
The client needed to modernize a legacy backend built on PHP and .NET Framework to support growing API request volume from frontend and mobile clients. Modernized a legacy PHP and .NET Framework backend to Node.js and Express.js with MongoDB on AWS, replacing an aging stack with a scalable microservices architecture. Designed a GraphQL API Gateway that reduced client-side API requests by 60% for frontend and mobile views, directly improving page load performance. Established automated testing (Mocha, Chai, Istanbul) integrated into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, enforcing quality gates on every deployment.

[Skills: React, JavaScript, Webpack, Gulp, REST]
[Context: Frontend Software Engineer at Hitss México, 2016-07 to 2016-10]
Contributed to frontend development for an insurance platform, building React components with ES6 syntax transpiled to ES5 using Webpack and Gulp for cross-browser compatibility. Worked as part of a geographically distributed team across Guadalajara, Aguascalientes, and San Francisco, coordinating daily activities through Scrum ceremonies. Collaborated with backend engineers to integrate RESTful APIs into React-based user interfaces.

[Skills: JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, Angular, Git]
[Context: Fullstack Software Engineer at Ramsal Software, 2015-08 to 2016-06]
First professional software engineering role, contributing to the development of Ramsal, a SaaS payroll management platform serving multiple enterprise clients. Built and maintained client-facing web modules using JavaScript and jQuery, delivering responsive interfaces for payroll processing and employee management workflows. Collaborated in developing an integrated Web System that consolidated multiple business tools into a cohesive enterprise application.

[Skills: JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, Angular, Git]
[Context: Fullstack Software Engineer at Ramsal Software, 2015-08 to 2016-06]
Acquired foundational proficiency in Node.js, Angular, and Git, establishing a strong base for full-stack development.

Licenciatura en Informática Administrativa (B.S. in Management Information Systems) from Universidad América Latina, Guadalajara, Mexico. Graduated with Honors (GPA-based).
